scope: Unsigned next-transaction encoding and read-only gas simulation, not actual deposit submission.

deposit_contract.selector_validation: Offline Keccak-256 using installed transitive pointycastle; no dependency added. Exact ABI vectors in deposit_transaction_test.dart.
deposit_contract.receiver: Current identity EOA/Privy wallet, never a replacement wallet.
deposit_contract.native: 18 decimals, msg.value == amount in exact smallest units.
deposit_contract.erc20: msg.value = 0. Sufficient allowance -> deposit; zero insufficient allowance -> approve(vault,exact amount); nonzero insufficient allowance -> approve(vault,0) first. Reset is a conservative client policy, not a claim every token requires it.
deposit_contract.boundaries: normal routes only; validated nonzero addresses, uint256 units, known chain and native metadata. No unlimited approval, direct transfer fallback, wallet switch, signature or broadcast.

simulation.fresh_read: Reuse full fixed-block wallet read with chain/precision/balance/allowance/hash validation.
simulation.nonce: latest == pending; reject pending transactions, invalid 64-bit nonce and changed pending nonce after simulation.
simulation.call: Exact from/to/data/value, quoted legacy gasPrice and pending nonce; eth_estimateGas(call,pending).
simulation.gas_limit: ceil(estimate * 120 / 100); 20% is a client reserve policy, not a chain fee guarantee.
simulation.native_required: native value + gas limit * quoted legacy gas price, exact BigInt; require native balance >= total.
simulation.postcheck: Fixed block hash unchanged, padded limit <= captured block gasLimit, pending nonce unchanged.
simulation.freshness: Earliest of wallet.receivedAt + 30s, quote.receivedAt + 30s and blockTime + 2min. Refuse invalid future times. No automatic polling.
simulation.rpc_safety: Read-only allowlist; broadcast/sign methods refused before network. Standard error envelopes without result accepted then safely mapped; raw node details never displayed.
simulation.ui: Explicit step and amount, copyable wallet/target, value/units/limit/gasPrice/reserve/total/time. Failure retains stale quote, amount changes mark previous amount; no submit action, native Max stays disabled.
simulation.scope: Identity/address/wallet-kind/signing-availability changes clear quote and invalidate pending work; stop/disposal discard late results; screen retains family while lazy children scroll offscreen.

remaining: Actual chain switch and wallet transaction submission, allowance and deposit receipts, replacement/reorg handling, platform credit and durable unknown-result recovery.
User/platform caps depend on website private BAPI with no validated third-party login this phase; missing caps are not unlimited.
Each quote covers only current reset/approval/deposit step, not later steps or final network fees. Re-read and re-estimate after any state change.
Real RPC simulation, wallet integration, Android/iOS native layouts and storage remain unverified; no device tooling or APK installation this phase.
